statements.t: The Company is updating its full year revenue growth guidance range to $4,741 million - $4,767 million, or reported growth of 10.1% - 10.8%, an increase of $32 million at midpoint, including $5 million related to the recent CoVet acquisition.
The Company is increasing its outlook for organic revenue growth to 9.3% - 10.0%, an increase of 0.6% at midpoint, reflecting operational performance.

The Company lowered its full year reported operating margin outlook to 32.1% - 32.3%, bringing the projected full year operating profit margin expansion to 50 - 70 basis points as reported and on a comparable basis.
The Company updated its EPS outlook range to $14.96 - $15.16, a $0.25 increase compared to prior guidance midpoint, reflecting 15% reported and 16% comparable growth.
